latest_release.name: v11.1.0
latest_release.body:
## Release 2026-11-11 V11.1.0

### Fixes
* fix(Calendar): honour FirstDayOfWeek for the month start and the week header by @rabauss in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8658
* fix(ImageViewer): use PreviewIndex on initial render by @ArgoZhang in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8689
* fix(Theme): resolve auto theme for dependent UI by @ArgoZhang in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8691
* fix(DockView): persist active panel when renderer is always by @ArgoZhang in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8701

### Features
* feat(ValidateForm): add EnableFieldValueChanged parameter by @ArgoZhang in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8655
* feat(ColorPicker): bump pickr version 1.10.3 by @ArgoZhang in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8671
* feat(Holiday): update holiday data for 2027 by @ArgoZhang in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8683
* feat(DateTimePicker/Range): improve user experience on mobile by @Tony-ST0754 in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8663
* feat(EmbedPDF): update embed-pdf-viewer to v3.0.0 by @ArgoZhang in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8695
* feat(DriverJs): update DriverJs to v1.11.0 by @ArgoZhang in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8699
* feat(IP2Region): update IPv4 region data by @ArgoZhang in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8704
* feat(Dom2Image): update SnapDOM to v3.7.4 by @ArgoZhang in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8707
* feat(Scroll): add instance method ScrollTo by @Tony-ST0754 in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8705
* feat(NET11`): support NET11 framework by @ArgoZhang in https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/pull/8711

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dotnetcore/BootstrapBlazor/compare/v11.0.2...v11.1.0
